targets.rawSql: SELECT u.name as developer, DATE(c.created_at_gitlab) as time, COUNT(*) as commits FROM commits c JOIN users u ON u.gitlab_id = (SELECT gitlab_id FROM users WHERE email = c.author_email LIMIT 1) WHERE $__timeFilter(c.created_at_gitlab) GROUP BY u.name, DATE(c.created_at_gitlab) ORDER BY time

SELECT u.name as developer, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hm.date + (hm.hour || ' hours')::INTERVAL) as time, SUM(hm.commit_count) as value FROM hourly_metrics hm JOIN users u ON u.user_id = hm.user_id WHERE $__timeFilter(hm.date) GROUP BY u.name, hm.date, hm.hour ORDER BY hm.date, hm.hour

SELECT u.name as developer, COUNT(DISTINCT p.name) as active_projects, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ', ') as projects FROM active_projects_snapshot aps JOIN users u ON u.user_id = aps.user_id JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = aps.project_id WHERE aps.date = CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY u.name ORDER BY active_projects DESC

SELECT u.name as developer, SUM(c.stats_additions) as additions FROM commits c JOIN users u ON u.gitlab_id = (SELECT gitlab_id FROM users WHERE email = c.author_email LIMIT 1) WHERE $__timeFilter(c.created_at_gitlab) GROUP BY u.name
SELECT dm.date as time, u.name as developer, dm.commit_count FROM daily_metrics dm JOIN users u ON u.user_id = dm.user_id WHERE $__timeFilter(dm.date) ORDER BY dm.date

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', dm.date) as time, u.name as developer, SUM(dm.commit_count) as commits FROM daily_metrics dm JOIN users u ON u.user_id = dm.user_id WHERE $__timeFilter(dm.date) GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', dm.date), u.name ORDER BY time

SELECT hm.hour as hour, u.name as developer, AVG(hm.commit_count) as avg_commits FROM hourly_metrics hm JOIN users u ON u.user_id = hm.user_id WHERE hm.date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY hm.hour, u.name ORDER BY hm.hour

SELECT 'Total Commits' as metric, COUNT(*) as value FROM commits WHERE created_at_gitlab >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' UNION ALL SELECT 'Desarrolladores Activos', COUNT(DISTINCT author_email) FROM commits WHERE created_at_gitlab >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' UNION ALL SELECT 'Proyectos Activos', COUNT(DISTINCT project_id) FROM commits WHERE created_at_gitlab >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
